# Title:Coach: Exploiting Temporal Patterns for All-Resource Oversubscription in Cloud Platforms

Authors:[Benjamin Reidys](https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&query=Reidys,+B), [Pantea Zardoshti](https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&query=Zardoshti,+P), [Íñigo Goiri](https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&query=Goiri,+%C3%8D), [Celine Irvene](https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&query=Irvene,+C), [Daniel S. Berger](https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&query=Berger,+D+S), [Haoran Ma](https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&query=Ma,+H), [Kapil Arya](https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&query=Arya,+K), [Eli Cortez](https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&query=Cortez,+E), [Taylor Stark](https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&query=Stark,+T), [Eugene Bak](https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&query=Bak,+E), [Mehmet Iyigun](https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&query=Iyigun,+M), [Stanko Novaković](https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&query=Novakovi%C4%87,+S), [Lisa Hsu](https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&query=Hsu,+L), [Karel Trueba](https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&query=Trueba,+K), [Abhisek Pan](https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&query=Pan,+A), [Chetan Bansal](https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&query=Bansal,+C), [Saravan Rajmohan](https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&query=Rajmohan,+S), [Jian Huang](https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&query=Huang,+J), [Ricardo Bianchini](https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&query=Bianchini,+R)

View a PDF of the paper titled Coach: Exploiting Temporal Patterns for All-Resource Oversubscription in Cloud Platforms, by Benjamin Reidys and 18 other authors

[View PDF](/pdf/2501.11179) [HTML (experimental)](https://arxiv.org/html/2501.11179v2)

> Abstract:Cloud platforms remain underutilized despite multiple proposals to improve their utilization (e.g., disaggregation, harvesting, and oversubscription). Our characterization of the resource utilization of virtual machines (VMs) in Azure reveals that, while CPU is the main underutilized resource, we need to provide a solution to manage all resources holistically. We also observe that many VMs exhibit complementary temporal patterns, which can be leveraged to improve the oversubscription of underutilized resources.  
> Based on these insights, we propose Coach: a system that exploits temporal patterns for all-resource oversubscription in cloud platforms. Coach uses long-term predictions and an efficient VM scheduling policy to exploit temporally complementary patterns. We introduce a new general-purpose VM type, called CoachVM, where we partition each resource allocation into a guaranteed and an oversubscribed portion. Coach monitors the oversubscribed resources to detect contention and mitigate any potential performance degradation. We focus on memory management, which is particularly challenging due to memory's sensitivity to contention and the overhead required to reassign it between CoachVMs. Our experiments show that Coach enables platforms to host up to ~26% more VMs with minimal performance degradation.
